notes:
REF-BM-03: Collected title and description can be edited only after the bookmark has already been saved.
REF-BM-05: No delete endpoint or user interface exists.
REF-BM-17: Bookmarks have no unread/read-later state.
REF-BM-18: There is no separate unread view or filter.
REF-BM-19: There is no action for marking a bookmark read.
REF-BM-20: There is no multi-selection or bulk-action support.
REF-BM-21: No action can be applied to the complete currently filtered collection.
REF-BM-22: Results use a fixed updated-time ordering with no selectable sort key.
REF-BM-24: No local HTML snapshot or PDF-download implementation exists.
REF-BM-25: No Internet Archive snapshot integration exists.
REF-BM-26: Bookmarks cannot be archived or hidden reversibly.
REF-BM-27: Neither permanent deletion nor reversible archiving is implemented.
REF-BM-28: There is no archived-bookmarks view.
REF-BM-29: Saved search/tag bundles are not implemented.
REF-BM-30: Netscape HTML import is not implemented.
REF-BM-31: Netscape HTML export is not implemented.
REF-BM-32: No personal display-settings interface or persistence exists.
